scientific_integrity: Analytic theorem with a complete proof for an explicitly assumed stationary partial-overlap monitoring model. No external independent validation or calibrated field prediction is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent event starts on a circle
Event duration has finite mean and strictly positive continuous density for positive times
Any strictly positive overlap causes detection
Per-activation overhead consumes energy-equivalent live-time budget only
No inference to full-call detectors, changing biological call intensity, or reliable abundance estimation
Historical priority subject to uninspected earlier surveillance theory
title: A universal mean-duration boundary and integer staircase for overhead-limited recording windows
